# Font Awesome Free Solid icons

Source: https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/tree/7.x/svgs/solid

Copyright Fonticons, Inc. The SVG icon artwork is licensed under CC BY 4.0. See [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt). Each original SVG retains its attribution comment.

Selected path data and view boxes from these SVGs are embedded in `../../index.html` as local symbols. The app also scales these paths into QR SVG exports and rasterizes them for STL embossing. The NFC symbol in this project is an original drawing; the Font Awesome NFC icon is not included.
